list_dir.about: list one project folder; args: path (default '.')

read_file.about: read numbered lines of one project text file; args: path, start (default 1), lines (default 400)

search.about: regex search under a project folder; args: pattern, path (default '.'), max_hits (default 50)

run_check.about: run one command the project owner allowed, by name (e.g. 'test'); args: name
